proposed.explanation: The investor asked for the full‑year 2026 earnings per share (EPS) and the resulting price‑to‑earnings (P/E) ratio to judge whether ABUK is cheap enough to buy. The only available earnings data are the nine‑months‑ended‑30‑September‑2026 figures. The report provides a verified basic EPS of 8.74 EGP for 9M2026 (evidence_id ABUK‑ABUK_9M2026_results‑p2‑31), but there is no data for the final quarter (October‑December 2026) and no guidance on how to annualise the nine‑month result. Consequently we cannot calculate a full‑year EPS or a P/E ratio. The revenue and net‑profit rows are marked AMBIGUOUS and have been listed as unused_figures; they cannot be used in any calculation. Because the necessary figures to derive a full‑year EPS and P/E are missing, a responsible recommendation cannot be made. This response follows the rule set: no outside knowledge is used, only the supplied evidence, and the limitation is explicitly stated.
limitations: Only nine‑month EPS is available; no full‑year or quarterly data for Q4 2026.
